channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Magic Johnson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Magic Johnson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Derek Fisher on Magic Johnson
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Derek Fisher on Lebron:

“We could say this is his Magic Johnson era right now. You can still win championships with a guy like him leading the charge”

Derek Fisher on Magic Johnson, Apr 19, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kobe Sanders on Magic Johnson
item.description:
APHoops: Kobe Sanders on who he models his game after:

“Obviously a lot of KD ... I've watched a lot of DBook and how he gets to his spots ... My dad's favorite player was Magic Johnson so I kinda had to grow up being a guard.”

Kobe Sanders on Magic Johnson, Jan 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Magic Johnson
item.description:
Gilbert Arenas:

“And that's when the Jordan-loving media decided to start using those narratives in real time. No one before that was ever heard of as a member of a two-option ring. That wasn't a thing. It wasn't a thing. Like Magic Johnson, Johnson used to talk about I got five gold rings. I got three silvers. You're not going to take this credit for me getting to the finals and losing. You're not on the same planet as me. You didn't even make it to the finals. You're laughing at number two. It wasn't a thing. That wasn't a thing until LeBron James started winning. Then that became,”

Gilbert Arenas on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Magic Johnson, Aug 13, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Alex Rodriguez on Magic Johnson
item.description:
in his basketball ownership, Rodriguez told Andscape:

“Yes. That is what I do. I represent both. And the reason why I am here is because I saw Magic [Johnson] wearing a suit and tie. I said, ‘That was a guy I can relate with. He looks like me. He came from the bottom like me.’ “Ican’t put myself in his shoes. But when Magic [became a Los Angeles Lakers minority owner], it kind of ignited my vision. ‘Why not me? Why not you? Why not us?’ I’d like to affect one person to say, ‘This is a guy who is a former athlete who has been through some ups and downs, course-corrected and is someone who can lead others to their dreams.”

Alex Rodriguez on Magic Johnson, Jul 17, 2025. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
Thompson:

“That’s one of the greatest partnerships ever. You can compare it to peanut butter and jelly. They’re one of the greatest duos of all time. No question about it. They won four championships together. You have to win championships together to be compared to Scottie Pippen and Michael Jordan or to Magic Johnson and Kareem Abdul-Jabbar or Tim Duncan and Manu Ginobili and Tony Parker. They are definitely in that category or that conversation.”

Klay Thompson on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Nov 12, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Paul George on Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Paul George:

“Obviously, Anthony Edwards is super talented and is a huge talent going forward, but just how much the game has grown and how far you got to pay dues to those dudes that did it before us, and I think that's just where the translation between that era and his era…They don't really know too much about Magic Johnson and Larry Bird. Obviously, MJ is moving how guys move in this era today, so I think that was kind of like where he was going with it, as far as the movement and the explosiveness, the athleticism, and being able to contort your body.”

Paul George on Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Anthony Edwards, Sep 4, 2024. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: James Worthy on Magic Johnson, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
SportsComedyRap: James Worthy on greatness of Jokic:

“To me Jokic is Magic Johnson & Kareem on the floor at the same time.”

James Worthy on Magic Johnson, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Nikola Jokic, Apr 22, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Grant Williams on Magic Johnson
item.description:
When asked whether or not he thought he would be in Boston for seasons to come, Williams answered with some of his classic humor, via the Kenny Beecham Podcast.

“Whatever that Magic Johnson meme is. Let's just say that that's exactly how I was going into it,”

Grant Williams on Magic Johnson, Nov 11, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar on Magic Johnson
item.description:
“I was asked earlier this week who was the best point guard in the NBA, a very difficult question. Steph Curry was mentioned, he's the best 3-point shooter in the NBA these days and a very valuable player. And people also mentioned Magic Johnson,”

Kareem Abdul-Jabbar on Magic Johnson, Sep 17, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Kobe Bryant, Dirk Nowitzki, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan
item.description:
Stephen Curry:

“I am blessed to know and hope that no matter how many years I do play, playing for one franchise and being a part of that group of the legends that have accomplished that feat and won at the highest level and all that. I don’t ever take that for granted either. You got the Kobe [Bryant]’s, the Magic [Johnson]’s, Dirk [Nowitzki], Tim Duncan, those guys helped establish a culture, won, did it with a lot of different roster combinations and different parts in their career.”

Stephen Curry on Kobe Bryant, Dirk Nowitzki, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan, Aug 29, 2023. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Tracy McGrady on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird
item.description:
Tracy McGrady:

“You look at some of the greats that have come through this game. And I'm not saying Magic Johnson was lucky, but Magic Johnson played with a lot of freaking Hall of Famers. I'm not saying Larry Bird was lucky either. He played with a lot of Hall of Famers as well. Jordan wasn't so lucky of playing with a lot of Hall of Famers. He just had a great sidekick in Scottie Pippen. But if you look at Jordan before Scottie Pippen became Scottie Pippen, Jordan was just a great individual player. Like,Jordan wasn't getting out of the first round or going deep into the playoffs before Scottie Pippen became Scottie Pippen.”

Tracy McGrady on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Jul 26, 2023. Source: YouTube.

item.title: LeBron James on Kobe Bryant, Shaquille O'Neal, Jerry West, Magic Johnson
item.description:
James said.

“I’m going Magic [Johnson] at 1, Jerry West at the 2, Kobe [Bryant] at the 3, myself at the 4 and Shaq (Shaquille O’Neal) at the 5.”

LeBron James on Kobe Bryant, Shaquille O'Neal, Jerry West, Magic Johnson, Sep 28, 2022. Source: Lakers Daily.

item.title: Draymond Green on Magic Johnson, Mateen Cleaves, Steve Smith
item.description:
“To be mentioned with guys like Mateen Cleaves, Magic Johnson, Steve Smith, Bubba Smith and Kirk Gibson is absolutely mind-blowing to me,”

Draymond Green on Magic Johnson, Mateen Cleaves, Steve Smith, Jul 12, 2022. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Magic Johnson
item.description:
“And you know, I think a lot of it came from—Magic Johnson should have been Michael Jordan before Michael Jordan. He had the smile. He had everything. He had the marketability. He had championships.”

Michael Jordan on Magic Johnson, Apr 1, 2022. Source: The Ringer.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Magic Johnson
item.description:
“I learned from the great Magic Johnson that it’s okay to be a superstar basketball player, but at some point you want to go and invest in businesses,”

Shaquille O'Neal on Magic Johnson, Mar 1, 2022. Source: CNBC.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Magic Johnson
item.description:
Callie Caplan:Jason Kidd on Luka buying into Mavs' defensive focus:

“He’ll let you know when he has 3 blocks [and say] he should be on first team all-defense. That’s fun because he has that Magic Johnson, Giannis fun. Understanding that might not be his strength, but he’s giving everything.”

Jason Kidd on Magic Johnson, Jan 20, 2022. Source: Twitter @CallieCaplan.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Magic Johnson, Oscar Robertson
item.description:
Westbrook said in April of the triple-doubles.

“I honestly make sure I impact the game in many ways every night — defending, rebounding, passing, whatever it is my team needs from me to win. That’s what I do. I don’t care what people think about it. … “I think it’s very interesting that it’s not useful when I’m doing it. It wasn’t useful when Magic (Johnson) and Oscar (Robertson) and those guys were doing it? Now that I do it and it looks easy; this shit ain’t easy, though. I’ll tell you that. It ain’t easy.”

Russell Westbrook on Magic Johnson, Oscar Robertson, Dec 10, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: World B. Free on Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird
item.description:
former Warrior World B. Free said.

“It’s a person that just knows what he’s doing, knows he’s good. Not many guys have it. You know Michael Jordan had it. Magic Johnson. Larry Bird. Dr. J. Allen Iverson. It factors. When you see those guys coming, you know you’re in for a long night.”

World B. Free on Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Apr 13, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Magic Johnson
item.description:
O’Neal, 48, told John that is wasn’t until he signed with Los Angeles Lakers in 1996 that he got the best money advice ever from Magic Johnson.

“When I first got to L.A., [Johnson] said ’Shaq, it’s okay to be famous and all that but at some point, you want to start owning things,”

Shaquille O'Neal on Magic Johnson, Oct 26, 2020. Source: CNBC.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Michael Jordan, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Mavericks coachRick Carlisle on Luka Doncic after exit from playoffs:

“Hell come back next year even better, with something new in his game, the same way as Larry Bird, Magic Johnson and Michael Jordan and all those greats. He has an irrepressible enthusiasm for the game.”

Rick Carlisle on Michael Jordan, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Luka Doncic, Aug 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Jerry Reinsdorf on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Magic Johnson, Oscar Robertson
item.description:
Jerry Reinsdorf:

“In my mind, anytime anybody wants to talk to me about comparing Michael to LeBron (James), I’m going to tell them to please don’t waste my time. I’m really pleased it showed how great Michael was to people who hadn’t seen him play. I’m truly tired of people trying to compare LeBron to Michael when it’s not even close. They should try to compare LeBron with Oscar Robertson or Magic Johnson. Michael was so head and shoulders over everybody, and that really came out in this documentary. He was a phenomenon. We may never see another like him.”

Jerry Reinsdorf on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Magic Johnson, Oscar Robertson, Jun 6, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Jerry Buss on Magic Johnson
item.description:
It ended suddenly when Johnson had to retire in 1991 because of an HIV diagnosis.

“I prayed to the skies above and I said if we ever get a player on our team like Magic Johnson again, I will never ever, ever take that player for granted,”

Jerry Buss on Magic Johnson, May 25, 2020. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Isiah Thomas, Magic Johnson
item.description:
“To me, if the best point guard of all time is Magic Johnson, and right behind him is Isiah Thomas. No matter how much I hate him, I respect his game.”

Michael Jordan on Isiah Thomas, Magic Johnson, May 4, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: LeBron James on Magic Johnson
item.description:
LeBron James on being the only Laker since Magic Johnson to have 502 assists before the all-star break:

“It's my responsibility. The coach has put me at the PG position at the start of the season & my teammates put the trust in me to be able to handle the ball as much as I do..”

LeBron James on Magic Johnson, Feb 5, 2020. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Magic Johnson
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Doc Rivers on Magic Johnson's resignation last night:

“Happiness is underrated, you know? If that's what you want, you should be able to get it. I'm happy for him.”

Doc Rivers on Magic Johnson, Apr 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Josh Hart on Magic Johnson
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Josh Hart on Magic Johnson:

“At the end of the day, he made a decision that he thought was best for him. We wish him all the luck. We're grateful for the two years he had with us. Wish him the best of luck. That's about it.”

Josh Hart on Magic Johnson, Apr 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Magic Johnson
item.description:
Kyle Kuzma on Magic Johnson:

“For Magic, he's Magic Johnson. He doesn't need to prove to anybody anything. He just made the best decision for him. That's all you can ask and that's all anybody in this world would want to do for themselves.”

Kyle Kuzma on Magic Johnson, Apr 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Magic Johnson
item.description:
Kyle Kuzma on Magic Johnson resigning as Lakers president:

“To be honest, I was a little bit shocked. Just like everybody else was. It wasn't predicted. Nobody had that on their minds.”

Kyle Kuzma on Magic Johnson, Apr 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Lance Stephenson on LeBron James, Magic Johnson
item.description:
James didn’t personally call him after signing his four-year, $154 million contract with the Lakers over the offseason.

“Magic (Johnson) called me and he told me LeBron was interested, very interested in me,”

Lance Stephenson on LeBron James, Magic Johnson, Aug 29, 2018. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Michael Cooper on Magic Johnson, Lonzo Ball, Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Michael Cooper on Lonzo Ball & Kyle Kuzma:

“Lonzo Ball has shown that he’s kind of like a Magic Johnson-type of player. He’s the type of player that makes other players around him better. I think Kyle Kuzma has shown that he can shoot the ball with some of the best.”

Michael Cooper on Magic Johnson, Lonzo Ball, Kyle Kuzma, Aug 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.
